stories.title: Formative study finds situational awareness design improves interface
stories.summary: A new human-machine interface framework integrates cognitive principles into remote agricultural vehicle dashboards to assist operator awareness. The layout translates Endsley’s situational awareness theory and ISO 9241 ergonomic standards into a three-panel design. The development responds to the increasing adoption of automated guided vehicles in precision agriculture.

stories.title: AI-enabled pediatric rehabilitation prototype retains acceptable usability
stories.summary: A study of an AI-enabled software platform for pediatric goal setting found the system maintained acceptable usability. While the platform overall was considered feasible, the integrated conversational agent received very poor usability ratings from participating caregivers. The evaluation was conducted with families in an urban early intervention program.

stories.title: If AI works from anywhere, why are we commuting to watch it?
stories.summary: Companies claim office attendance is about collaboration, but the reality is a room full of people in headphones doing work they could have done at home. Alexa von Tobel noted she has not been pitched a single remote-only company in six months.

stories.title: Too Claudified
stories.summary: A client rejected motion work for looking machine-made. The designer had published the diagnosis five months earlier.

stories.title: When everything has changed, what do we do next?
stories.summary: Tech hyperscalers and AI startups have transformed the industry, regardless of whether they succeed in their quest to have everyone pay a subscription fee for LLM technology. The industry remains in flux, and many participants report feeling tired.

stories.title: This farming game is designed to keep you off your phone
stories.summary: The app Island: Screen Time Control asks users to grow virtual crops to stay off their phones. Founders of SideKit say the typical approach of nannying screen time does not work. The app bets that gamification can yield better long-term results than adding friction.

stories.title: The new luxury fitness experience is about more than equipment - Hotelier Middle East
What Indian enterprises are learning from AI chatbot development
stories.summary: Indian enterprises are using AI chatbots to automate conversations and improve service accessibility. However, deploying bots in real business environments has proven different from testing. Organizations are learning that they must consider regional languages, data security, and operational costs as they move beyond initial experimentation.

stories.title: CLAUDE.md new best practices
stories.summary: CLAUDE.md is a Markdown file that Claude Code loads every time it works on a project. The documentation has been updated following the release of Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.2.

stories.title: Coop household: Everyday utility packaging design by Bedow
stories.summary: Bedow adapted Coop’s circular plate into asymmetrical packaging for Nordic household goods. Half of the batteries on the carton are real metal cells, while the rest are printed gray silhouettes. The studio says this visual cue explains the system for products sold outside of grocery aisles.

stories.title: Discircle unveils Lemonade Global Ventures brand identity
stories.summary: Discircle built the brand identity for Lemonade Global Ventures using a gold lemon globe, zero sugar discipline, and a black and acid yellow color system. The mark fuses a lemon with a globe, with longitudinal lines reading as both citrus segments and earth meridians.

stories.title: DesignStudio’s cross-border brand identity for Eurostar
stories.summary: DesignStudio united Eurostar and Thalys under one identity, pairing a star mark with La Pontaise type and giant graphics. The rail operator aims to double annual ridership to 30 million passengers by 2030. The oversized star on the train cab is intended to serve as a unified brand.

stories.title: Parniera brand identity: Inside Igor Nora’s sculpted system
stories.summary: Igor Nora built the Parniera brand identity using silk and sculpted gold. The project, titled Sculpted Duality, pairs fluid motion with architectural weight. The identity is designed for a woman who commands the room with quiet power, using a yellow field and black line work.

stories.title: Fractional: Calm AI product UI/UX design by Mano a Mano
stories.summary: Mano a Mano designed the UI/UX for the AI platform Fractional using Zen garden grids and calm agent views. The studio avoided sci-fi dashboard tropes in favor of raked sand and painted stone aesthetics. The design connects teams, scattered tools, and AI agents for small businesses.

stories.title: Samsung's fluid AI design could be the blueprint for One UI 10
stories.summary: Samsung may be preparing a visual overhaul for One UI 10, expected in 2027. A leaked banner shows a translucent number with a frosted-glass finish, fueling speculation about a redesign based on the company's Fluid AI Design system. The concept features floating cards and blurred backgrounds.

stories.title: Graphic design: Amsterdam museum night posters by From Form
stories.summary: Rotterdam duo From Form used 17th-century dioramas and surrealism for its fifth Amsterdam Museum Night campaign. The designers dropped their earlier habit of balancing historic cues with modern polish. The posters feature hands in lace cuffs crossing flashlight beams over a white wordmark.

stories.title: Helvetica: The typeface everyone respects but nobody questions
stories.summary: Helvetica is used on train tickets, tax returns, and airline logos. Swiss designer Max Miedinger created the typeface in 1957. It is described as a typeface people respect but do not question, leading to a complicated affection for a font that has been praised into invisibility.

stories.title: A good designer can make a free font look expensive
stories.summary: Designer Callum Abbott discussed going solo and creating publications without a budget for photography or illustration. For The Other Almanac, Abbott and editor Ana Ratner devised a vision that worked around strict parameters, including the use of no new images.

stories.title: Accelerate Enterprise Campaign Production with Multimodal AI - Adobe for Business
Room AI relaunches as an interior design assistant
Judge orders Adobe to stop using the Foundry name on its Firefly AI model service - MLQ.ai
Instagram adds post-publication editing for stories
stories.summary: Instagram now allows users to edit text, music, stickers, and drawings on Stories for up to 15 minutes after posting. The update lets creators fix errors without losing engagement metrics like views or replies. Previously, fixing a typo required deleting and reposting the entire story.

stories.title: OpenAI claims its models optimized AMD chip designs
stories.summary: OpenAI says its models achieved up to 14 percent improvement in power, performance, and chip area on AMD flagship GPU designs in under five months. The company claims this represents a year of progress on top of existing engineering. Some changes are already in manufacturing.

stories.title: How to rescue low-res logos and old product photos with Adobe Firefly’s Generative Upscale: try for free - Softonic
Adobe Firefly expands AI audio generation features
stories.summary: Adobe is expanding its Firefly generative AI suite to include audio generation tools. The company suggests that AI-driven audio, ranging from music mixing to generating new tracks for global release, is becoming a primary focus for creators. Adobe aims to dominate the emerging AI audio market.

stories.title: OpenAI grants on-site access to independent auditors
stories.summary: OpenAI is providing four outside organizations with on-site access to unreleased models, source code, and training data to investigate safety risks. The program fulfills commitments from the White House Accord on Super Intelligence. Auditors can also conduct confidential interviews with the company's developers.

stories.title: SPZAORA launches to integrate AI into interior design
stories.summary: SPZAORA is a new brand focused on interior design through the integration of AI. The company aims to support architects by combining design creativity with AI technology to improve visualization and planning. The brand was founded by Pavneet Singh Chawla to address demand for faster design processes.

stories.title: Webflow appoints Katie Chisam as chief marketing officer
stories.summary: Webflow has named Katie Chisam as its new chief marketing officer. Chisam, who joined the company in 2025 as chief of staff, will lead marketing efforts as the firm prepares to launch its agentic platform, Source by Webflow. She previously oversaw revenue marketing and business strategy.

Canva QR code generator alternatives for 2026
stories.summary: Canva's QR tool requires an account and limits users to web addresses. Dedicated generators now offer more content types and editable codes. While some older guides claim Canva only produces permanent codes, the platform has changed, making a comparison of current features necessary for users.

stories.title: Paperwall offers free browser-based design alternative
stories.summary: Paperwall is an open-source design tool that functions in a browser without requiring accounts, subscriptions, or watermarks. It provides templates and fonts for creating graphics and presentations. The tool is positioned as a stripped-down alternative to Canva for users seeking to avoid sign-up requirements.

stories.title: Enrichable by Context.dev
stories.summary: Enrichable is an open-source AI spreadsheet designed for data enrichment tasks. The project is currently available for community discussion.

stories.title: Cadence joins European Chip Design Platform to support semiconductor startups and SMEs - New Electronics
Hyderabad student launches AI platform
stories.summary: Kiyan, a 13-year-old student at Delhi Public School, has launched KIKA AI. The platform is designed to empower users to explore, create and build using artificial intelligence. Developed in 11 weeks, the project has already secured backing from an initial seed investor.

stories.title: Apple updates Maps for India
stories.summary: Apple has rolled out a redesigned map experience in India featuring 300 three-dimensional landmarks and enhanced navigation. The update includes Natural Language Guidance, which provides directions using conversational phrases and real-world details like pillars to assist users on roads that lack formal names.

stories.title: Maruti Suzuki DesignXathon Finale Held in Gurugram - evo India
SpazioLiv offers custom interior design
stories.summary: Luxury interior design firm SpazioLiv is marketing its services as a quieter alternative to off-the-shelf home interiors. The company says it plans each home as a single project, avoiding templates in favor of designs based on how families spend their days. Consultations are free.

stories.title: Luminous unveils new brand identity, targets 3X growth by 2030 - IMPACT Magazine
Anant Anadi Vadnagar Museum Wins Red Dot Best of the Best 2026 - CMO Gujarat
Andhra Pradesh amends semiconductor policy
stories.summary: Andhra Pradesh has amended its semiconductor policy to include a 5,000-acre park near Tirupati. The government says it will offer up to 80 per cent capital assistance for silicon fabrication units. The plan is aligned with the second phase of the India Semiconductor Mission.

stories.title: Zionik expands audio and mobile accessories
stories.summary: Bawa Electronics has expanded its Zionik brand, which offers wireless earphones, speakers, and mobile chargers. The products are manufactured in India with OEM services available. The company says the line is intended for everyday use, from home entertainment to travel and work.

stories.title: Humyn Labs raises $47 million
stories.summary: Physical AI startup Humyn Labs has raised $47 million in a Series A round comprising equity and debt. The Bengaluru-headquartered company plans to use the funds to build deployment-readiness infrastructure in Brazil, South Korea and India, while expanding its R&D presence in San Francisco and London.

stories.title: August AI raises $12 million for healthcare assistant
stories.summary: Healthtech startup August AI has raised $12 million to expand its healthcare assistant, which helps users book appointments and manage insurance claims. The company claims to have helped 10 million people understand their health through its AI companion. The startup previously raised $3 million in seed funding.

stories.title: Genesis AI raises $500 million
stories.summary: Robotics startup Genesis AI has raised $500 million at a $3.5 billion valuation. The round was co-led by Khosla Ventures, Premji Invest and Eclipse, with participation from Nvidia and Eric Schmidt. The company plans to use the capital to increase production of its general-purpose robot, Eno.

stories.title: Humyn Labs secures $47 million for robot training
stories.summary: Humyn Labs has raised $47 million to scale its business of recording humans to train robots. The funding, consisting of $26 million in equity and $21 million in debt, will support the expansion of robot deployment operations to Brazil, South Korea and India.

stories.title: Boba Bhai raises $18 million
stories.summary: QSR chain Boba Bhai has raised $18 million in a Series B round led by Left Lane Capital. Founder Dhruv Kohli stated that expansion is the company's sole priority. The fresh capital will be used to double down on existing markets and enter new ones.

stories.title: Qluster raises €4.7 million for quantum design
stories.summary: Paris-based startup Qluster has raised €4.7 million to design photonic quantum computers. The company says the industry race has focused too heavily on qubit power, and it intends to prioritize industrial needs instead. The startup was spun out of a research institution associated with three Nobel Prizes.

stories.title: Boltz raises $110 million as weekly use of its AI drug design models rises about 50-fold - MLQ.ai
Boltz raises $110 million for drug discovery AI
stories.summary: MIT-born startup Boltz has raised $110 million to sell proprietary AI models for biomolecule design. The company, which has signed six of the world’s 20 largest pharma firms, builds models that predict protein structures. It operates as a public benefit corporation based in Massachusetts.

stories.title: Botsync raises $11 million for factory automation
stories.summary: Robotics startup Botsync has raised $11 million to upgrade its factory automation software and mobile robots. The Singapore-based company plans to expand its engineering teams in India to support global deployments. With this round, the startup's total funding has surpassed $20 million.

stories.title: The biggest risk to a brand idea is what happens between agencies - Design Week
Creatives use AI daily, but few are earning more from it
stories.summary: Envato surveyed 1,033 creatives across 103 countries and found that AI use has become routine. Despite the widespread adoption of AI tools, most creatives report no increase in earnings. The report notes that many users do not disclose their AI usage to clients. Efficiency is improving, apparently.

stories.title: Fashion brands move into food and hospitality
stories.summary: Luxury brands are expanding into food and hospitality to translate their identity into new settings. Giulia Liu, founder of Gong Oriental Attitude, notes that fashion and food both have the power to make people dream. The challenge remains to avoid diluting the brand message while serving dinner.

stories.title: Thumbtack appoints Randy Hunt as first chief design officer
stories.summary: Thumbtack has named Randy Hunt as its first chief design officer to oversee product design, brand, and creative operations. Hunt previously led design for artificial intelligence products at Notion. He will now work to unify the company's product and brand design priorities.

stories.title: New York School of Interior Design to honor four leaders
stories.summary: The New York School of Interior Design will present three awards at its gala in Manhattan next year. Honorees include Kit Kemp, John and Christine Gachot, and Alessandra Marinello. The school recognizes individuals in residential or commercial design who have made significant contributions to the industry.

stories.title: George P. Johnson appoints Santiago Cuesta to lead creative in MENA
stories.summary: George P. Johnson has appointed Santiago Cuesta as executive creative director based in Dubai. Cuesta will lead the agency creative vision across the MENA region. He brings 15 years of leadership experience and has previously worked with brands including Coca-Cola, Unilever, and Intel.

stories.title: Yahoo Finance hires Freitas as VP of product and design
stories.summary: Yahoo Finance has hired Ryan Freitas as vice president of product and design. Freitas will focus on building personalized and intuitive experiences for financial users. He previously led design for connected commerce at JPMorgan Chase, where he managed teams across payments, wallets, and lending.

stories.title: Payette seeks director of interior design in Boston
stories.summary: Payette is recruiting for a director of interior design based in Boston. The firm requires a minimum of 15 years of experience and a portfolio showcasing innovative design solutions. The successful candidate will oversee all aspects of interior design projects from concept to completion.

Traditionally, DPMP controllers rely on heuristic (rule-based) decision. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

Adaptive deep brain. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Exploring multimodal AI--XR interactions for software development: From expert perspectives to semantic code outlines
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: AI tools can generate code quickly, but developers still need to understand and check the results. We explore how the enriched multimodal context derived from the extended reality (XR) workspace might help developers manage this information. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
